Learning

Make every next decision better informed.

Quick readMore contextTechnical detailSpeaker notes

Success is more than a count of awards or activities. A useful record explains what happened, what the evidence supports, and why the next step should continue, change, or stop.

A pilot to discuss: reusable research records

Connect one reviewed result to its sources, limitations, review, and next decision. Test whether someone outside the project can understand it.

Progress: Measure review effort, missing evidence, and useful reuse.

Why this belongs on the agenda

The SBIR handout presents competing views on repeated support. A productive discussion needs evidence of capability and transition, opportunities for newcomers, and clear reasons to continue or stop.

Define the pilot before judging it

Agree on the intended user, the barrier, a named owner, the starting conditions, and the evidence needed to judge progress. Preserve limitations and reasons for changing direction. A proposed pilot is not a funded program or a completed evaluation.
